basic_info.description: Dramatic unobstructed bay to ocean views. This fully detached 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom single family home boasts over approximately 3,740 square feet of living space with 600 square feet of outdoor view deck. With generous square footage and a flexible floor plan, this residence offers a rare opportunity to reimagine and modernize a classic San Francisco home.    Highlights include a rare 3 car garage parking with interior access, large walk-out panoramic view terrace, W/D, living room with wood-burning fireplace, ample storage.     Whether you're a homeowner with a designer's vision or a developer seeking your next project, this property is brimming with potential. A bit of sweat equity or a strategic renovation could transform this into a spacious retreat with many original details.
